caption: The video showcases a high-angle view of a serpentine line of multicolored dominoes laid on a plain concrete floor, with a white base section near the upper loop. At the opening, part of the upper loop is already falling, while the upper-middle row, lower row, and far-right gray tail remain upright. Several teal pieces tilt and drop over the white base, then the pink dominoes on the loop's right side lean and collapse. The falling front moves around the yellow curve at the lower right of the upper loop and travels leftward along the upper-middle row. It tips over standing pink, yellow, and teal dominoes, including horizontal bridge pieces, as it progresses toward the left curve. When the front reaches the left-hand curve of the upper-middle row, it turns downward into the lower horizontal row. The lower row then topples from left to right, while the right end of that row and the far-right gray run stay standing.
relations: The initial collapse of the upper loop tips adjacent dominoes, propagating the fall around the curve.
The falling front travels leftward along the upper-middle row, toppling upright pieces and bridges.
Reaching the left curve, the collapse turns downward into the lower horizontal row.
The lower row topples left-to-right, halting before the far-right gray tail falls.
